description: This file defines a PHP class `perf_oci8` extending `ADODB_perf`, providing performance monitoring and analysis tools for Oracle OCI8 database connections. It includes SQL queries for performance metrics, cache analysis, and SQL examination tools.

classes.name: perf_oci8
classes.description: Class for Oracle OCI8 performance monitoring, health checks, and SQL analysis.

methods.name: perf_oci8
methods.description: Constructor method initializing connection and version info.

methods.name: WarnPageCost
methods.description: Provides warning message based on page cost parameter.

methods.name: WarnIndexCost
methods.description: Provides warning about index cache cost parameter.

methods.name: PGA
methods.description: Analyzes PGA memory usage with Oracle 9i+.

methods.name: Explain
methods.description: Generates an execution plan explanation for a given SQL query.

methods.name: CheckMemory
methods.description: Performs Oracle 9i+ data cache size recommendations.

methods.name: SuspiciousSQL
methods.description: Identifies potentially problematic SQL statements based on buffer gets.

methods.name: ExpensiveSQL
methods.description: Finds SQL statements with high disk reads.
